entries.question: How do I reset my password?
entries.answer: Visit our login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your email address and we'll send you a reset link within 5 minutes. Click the link in the email and follow the instructions to create a new password. If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder.

entries.question: What is your refund policy?
entries.answer: We offer a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, store credit is available instead. To initiate a refund, contact support@example.com with your order number. Refunds are typically processed within 5-7 business days.

entries.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
entries.answer: Log into your account, navigate to Settings > Subscription, and click 'Cancel Subscription'. You'll retain access until the end of your current billing period. Cancellations are effective immediately after the current period ends.

entries.question: How do I contact support?
entries.answer: You can reach our support team at support@example.com or call 1-800-SUPPORT Monday to Friday 9am-5pm EST. For urgent issues, please call our priority support line during business hours. Average response time for emails is 24 hours.

entries.question: Where can I track my order?
entries.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking email with a unique tracking number. You can also visit 'My Orders' in your account dashboard to track all orders. Shipping typically takes 5-7 business days within the US.
